chapter: The Los Angeles music scene in the early 1930s
title: After-hours hanging out and being a family man
summary: Musicians hung out and jammed after hours, but Blakeney, with a wife and daughter, went home.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: During that time Mr. Blakeney, how did the musicians more or less entertain themselves? Was there any hanging out as we know it today after the gig?
Oh yes, we used to hang around certain places.
Were there after hours jam sessions?
Can you remember some of the clubs where the guys used to hang out?
Some of them probably didn't hang out too long, perhaps like yourself you had to get home to wives.
You had a wife and one son, was it, Mr. Blakeney?
You had a wife and one daughter at that time?
As we said previously, many of these musicians were very, very strong family men.
